hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Side pocket mandrel and gas lift valve
function: The tubing sub with an offset pocket that holds a wireline-retrievable gas lift valve; the valve opens to let annulus gas into the tubing.

tabs.overview: Several mandrels down the string; unloading valves above, the operating valve or orifice at the deepest point of injection; valves are pulled and set with slickline kickover tools.
tabs.engineering: Valve set pressures staged for the unloading sequence.
tabs.safety: Slickline work through the tree lubricator.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
